test_name: Check 1: Future ACLED events in features
potential_leakage_source: ACLED events occurring after month T included in month T features
details: ACLED event counts aggregated strictly within month T bounds (T_start <= date <= T_end).

test_name: Check 2: Future GDELT news in features
potential_leakage_source: GDELT articles published after month T included in month T features
details: GDELT SQLDATE filtered strictly to month T.

test_name: Check 3: Future World Bank indicator leakage
potential_leakage_source: Un-lagged contemporaneous annual World Bank GDP/Inflation metrics
details: World Bank indicators joined with strict 1-year lag (Month T in Year Y uses World Bank Y-1).

test_name: Check 4: Future V-Dem governance indicator leakage
details: V-Dem v16 governance metrics joined with strict 1-year lag (Month T uses V-Dem Y-1).

test_name: Check 5: Future SIPRI military spending leakage
details: SIPRI defense spending metrics joined with strict 1-year lag (Month T uses SIPRI Y-1).

test_name: Check 6: Future GTD terrorism data leakage
potential_leakage_source: Falsely imputing post-2021 GTD records as zero
details: GTD features set to NaN (unavailable) for post-2021 periods rather than fake zeroes.

potential_leakage_source: Features using target calculation or future T+1 activity
details: All features constructed strictly using information available at or before month T.

potential_leakage_source: Centered rolling window averages taking future months
details: Growth rates and rolling averages use backward-looking shifts exclusively.

potential_leakage_source: Fitting StandardScaler/MinMaxScaler on full dataset before split
details: Scaling postponed to Phase 3 model training pipeline (fit on Train only).

potential_leakage_source: Randomly shuffling time-series rows across train and test sets
details: Strict chronological split enforced (Train: 2015-2021, Val: 2022, Test: 2023-2026).

potential_leakage_source: Imputing missing values using full-dataset statistics
details: No full-dataset mean/median imputation performed in preprocessing.

potential_leakage_source: Selecting features based on correlations with target across full dataset
details: Feature selection postponed to training phase on training set.
